attr.title: Need for Speed: Underground
attr.desc: Native static binary recompilation of Need for Speed: Underground (SPEED.EXE) for Rockchip RK3326 and ARM64 Linux handhelds.
attr.inst: Copy your retail PC Need for Speed Underground installation files into the ports/nfsu/gamedata/ folder on your SD card. Required: SPEED.EXE, GLOBAL, CARS, TRACKS, SOUND, MOVIES.
